sources.title: ClinVar allele level tables joined to gnomAD v2 exomes and genomes (GRCh37)
sources.licence: ClinVar data are public domain (NCBI); gnomAD data are released under CC0; pipeline code MIT
sources.citation: Landrum MJ et al. ClinVar: improving access to variant interpretations. Nucleic Acids Res 2018. Zhang X et al. macarthur-lab/clinvar pipeline.

sources.title: InterVar evidence database (gene lists, OMIM inheritance, Orphanet summaries, 1000 Genomes zygosity)
sources.licence: InterVar is free for academic use; derived tables used for gene level annotation only
sources.citation: Li Q, Wang K. InterVar: clinical interpretation of genetic variants by the 2015 ACMG-AMP guidelines. Am J Hum Genet 2017.

sources.title: Curated gene lists (inheritance, haploinsufficiency, essential genes, OMIM disease genes)
sources.licence: MIT (lists); source annotations retain their own terms
sources.citation: MacArthur Lab gene_lists repository; Blekhman 2008; Berg 2013; ClinGen dosage sensitivity.

sources.title: Gene constraint (ExAC pLI) and LoFtool gene intolerance scores
sources.licence: Apache 2.0 (plugins); scores from ExAC (open) and Fadista et al.
sources.citation: Lek M et al. Analysis of protein coding genetic variation in 60,706 humans. Nature 2016. Fadista J et al. LoFtool. Bioinformatics 2017.

sources.title: Canonical GENCODE transcript exon models for GRCh37
sources.licence: Annotation table distributed with SpliceAI (PolyForm Strict for models; table used for exon structure only)
sources.citation: Jaganathan K et al. Predicting splicing from primary sequence with deep learning. Cell 2019.

sources.title: Human Phenotype Ontology, disease annotations and gene to phenotype map (release 2025-01-16)
sources.citation: Gargano MA et al. The Human Phenotype Ontology in 2024. Nucleic Acids Res 2024.

sources.title: Annotated variant mention corpora (tmVar, SETH, OSIRIS, Variome, MutationFinder, SNP)
sources.licence: Each corpus keeps its original licence (research use); PubMed abstracts are NLM records
sources.citation: Wei CH et al. tmVar 2013; Thomas P et al. SETH 2016; Furlong LI et al. OSIRIS 2008; Verspoor K et al. Variome 2013; Caporaso JG et al. MutationFinder 2007; Cejuela JM et al. nala 2017.
